detail: No Daily Job Report email found from onservicetitan.com as of this run (checked both afterDateTime=today and a broad newest-first search; newest matching Daily Job Report in the inbox is still 2026-10-31). Likely cause: US DST ended today (clocks fell back at 2am ET), but this task's cron (5 12 * * *, and the watchdog crons 30 12/5 13/5 14 * * *) are fixed UTC, not CRON_TZ=America/New_York. Yesterday the 8:08am ET report arrived ~12:08-12:13 UTC (EDT, UTC-4). Today, now in EST (UTC-5), that same 8:08am ET send time maps to ~13:08-13:13 UTC -- about an hour after this primary run (12:05 UTC) and likely also after Watchdog (12:30 UTC) and Watchdog 2 (13:05 UTC) fire. Only Watchdog 3 (14:05 UTC) is scheduled late enough to reliably catch it today. Recommend converting all four sync crons to CRON_TZ=America/New_York so this does not recur at the next DST change.
